newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Mirae, three other IPOs begin trading.
newsitem.headline: Mirae, three other IPOs begin trading.

text.p: Mirae Corp shares began trading for the first time on Friday at a base price of 70,000 won per share, brokers said.

Three other initial public offerings also began trading -- Kohap Petrochemical Corp at a base price of 15,000 won, Dong Won Fisheries Co Ltd at 13,000 won, and Wooshin Industries Co Ltd at 40,000 won.
The base price is the weighted average of bids and offers received by the exchange and sets the trading range for the first day of trading.
During the October offering, the subscription price for Mirae's 380,000 shares was set at 40,000 won per share. Mirae is a semiconductor inspection equipment maker.
The subscription price for chemical product and synthetic fibre manufacturer Kohap Petrochemical's 3.86 million shares was 10,500 won per share.
Dong Won, South Korea's largest fishery, saw a subscription price of 11,000 won for its 600,000 shares.
PVC maker Wooshin's subscription price for its 260,000 shares was set at 20,000 won per share.
